name: AMD CPPC Perf
description: [AMD] Set Collaborative Processor Performance to max.

name: AMD Boost Max
description: [AMD] Maximum precision boost via power plan.

name: NVIDIA Max Performance
description: [DESKTOP] Force prefer-maximum-performance power mode. Desktop-only — on a laptop this keeps the GPU at max power state with no thermal recovery window, causing worse throttling under sustained load, not better FPS.

name: NVIDIA No Telemetry
description: [NVIDIA] Disable NVIDIA telemetry service and reporting.

name: NVIDIA Shader Cache
description: [NVIDIA] Ensure shader disk cache is on for faster loads.

name: NVIDIA HDCP Off
description: [NVIDIA] Disable HDCP. Non-DRM displays only.

name: NVIDIA PCIe Max Link
description: [NVIDIA] Force PCIe link to max speed, prevent throttling.

name: NVIDIA No Power Gating
description: [NVIDIA] Disable GPU power gating, eliminate clock-up spikes.

name: AMD GPU Deep Sleep Off
description: [DESKTOP] Disable GPU core deep sleep for lower latency. Desktop-only — on a laptop this removes the GPU's thermal recovery window and causes worse throttling under sustained load.

name: AMD Chill Off
description: [AMD GPU] Disable Radeon Chill frame limiter.

name: AMD ULPS Off
description: [AMD GPU] Disable Ultra Low Power State, reduces stutter.

name: AMD No Energy Driver
description: [AMD GPU] Disable energy driver power management.

name: Laptop AC Performance
description: [LAPTOP] Maximum performance on AC power.

name: VOIDTUNE Power Plan
description: [LAPTOP] Create + activate the VOIDTUNE plan: Balanced's proven thermal behavior (a real laptop gained ~100 FPS going back to Balanced from max-performance) plus the latency fixes that don't generate heat — core parking off, USB selective suspend off, PCIe link power off. AC-only; battery behavior untouched.

name: CPU 100% Min/Max
description: [DESKTOP] Lock CPU at 100% min/max so it never throttles under load. Desktop-only — on a laptop this removes thermal recovery time and causes worse throttling, not less.

name: Perf Boost Mode
description: [DESKTOP] Aggressive processor turbo boost. Desktop-only — \

name: VOIDTUNE Power Plan
description: [DESKTOP] Create + activate the VOIDTUNE plan: Ultimate Performance base with Aggressive boost, max energy-performance preference, core parking off, USB selective suspend off, and PCIe link power off — every setting evidence-backed (Microsoft power-tuning docs, Bitsum, Calypto), and none of the folklore ones that hurt frame pacing (C-state/idle disable is deliberately excluded).

name: Prefer P-Cores for Foreground
description: [HYBRID CPU] Bias the scheduler toward the performance cores for the app you're using. Pairs with Auto Game Boost.

name: Win32 Priority Separation
description: Foreground apps get the largest CPU time slices.

name: No Power Throttling
description: Remove background CPU power limits.

name: Distribute Timers
description: Spread timer interrupts across all cores instead of core 0.

name: MMCSS Responsiveness
description: Reserve only 10% of CPU for background so games/audio get the rest — without fully starving the audio engine (SystemResponsiveness=0 causes pops).

name: HW GPU Scheduling
description: Enable hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling (HAGS). Helps on some systems, but is a coin-flip — on others it causes stutter and alt-tab lag. Opt-in; toggle off and reboot if you get hitching.

name: GPU Priority 8
description: Raise GPU scheduling priority for games.

name: TDR Delay
description: Raise GPU timeout delay to prevent driver-recovery crashes.

name: Direct Flip
description: Reduce display latency via forced direct flip.

name: Disable MPO
description: Fix Multi-Plane Overlay stutter. May flicker on some GPUs.

name: Async Present
description: Enable asynchronous GPU presentation for lower frame latency.

name: D3D12 Independent Flip
description: Force D3D12 independent flip, reduces DWM overhead.

name: Async Compute
description: Enable asynchronous GPU compute for better utilisation.

name: No Framebuffer Compression
description: Disable GPU framebuffer compression, reduces latency on some hardware.

name: DWM Queue Size
description: Limit DWM queued buffers to 2 for lower display latency.

name: Clear Temp & DNS
description: Flush temp files and the DNS cache (one-shot).

name: Optimal Page File
description: Auto-size the pagefile to 1.5x RAM initial / 3x RAM max.

name: No Network Throttling
description: Remove the QoS network-throttling index.

name: Disable RSC
description: Disable Receive Segment Coalescing, reduces latency spikes.

name: Low-Latency UDP
description: Disable UDP Receive Offload — URO coalesces incoming UDP packets for throughput, which adds a little latency. Games (UDP) want them delivered immediately, so this keeps them uncoalesced.

name: Disable Telemetry
description: Stop and disable the DiagTrack service.

name: Block Ads
description: Stop ContentDeliveryManager suggested content.

name: Disable Cortana
description: Remove Cortana and Bing search.

name: Disable Game Bar
description: Remove Xbox Game Bar capture overhead.

name: Disable Animations
description: Set visual effects to best performance.

name: Disable Superfetch
description: Stop the SysMain preloading service.

name: Disable Aero Peek
description: Remove the hover-to-peek desktop effect.

name: Disable Aero Shake
description: Stop shake-to-minimize all windows.

name: Disable Snap Assist
description: Remove the snap-layout popup when dragging windows.

name: Menu Delay = 0
description: Instant menu open, no hover delay.

name: No Thumbnail Cache
description: Skip building thumbcache.db on network/temp drives.

name: Disable Sticky Keys
description: Turn off sticky/filter/toggle keys popups.

name: Disable Startup Sound
description: Mute the Windows boot/logon sound.

name: Disable Suggested Content
description: Stop Settings-app suggestions and 'ways to finish setup' nags.

name: Disable Copilot
description: Turn off Windows Copilot — removes its background host. (Windows 11)

name: Disable Widgets
description: Disable the Widgets board — stops Widgets.exe / WebExperience host. (Windows 11)

name: Edge Background Off
description: Disable Edge startup boost and background mode — no idle msedge.exe.

name: Disable OneDrive Sync
description: Block OneDrive sync engine from auto-running.

name: Disable Web Search
description: Kill Bing/web results in Start — trims SearchHost web calls.

name: Disable Clipboard History
description: Turn off clipboard history sync service.

name: Disable Spotlight & Tips
description: Stop lockscreen Spotlight, tips and suggestion content jobs.

name: Disable Storage Sense
description: Stop the automatic Storage Sense cleanup task.

name: Disable Geolocation Svc
description: Stop the location framework service (lfsvc).

name: Disable AllJoyn Router
description: Stop the AllJoyn IoT router service (AJRouter).

name: Disable NFC/Payments Svc
description: Stop the Payments and NFC/SE manager (SEMgrSvc).

name: Disable Compat Assistant
description: Stop Program Compatibility Assistant service (PcaSvc).

name: Disable Connected Devices
description: Stop Connected Devices Platform service (CDPSvc) — many background callbacks.

name: Disable Diagnostic Policy
description: Stop the Diagnostic Policy Service (DPS) — heavy WdiServiceHost spawns.

name: Disable Error Reporting Svc
description: Stop Windows Error Reporting service (WerSvc) — removes WerFault background work.

name: Disable Link Tracking
description: Stop Distributed Link Tracking (TrkWks) — tracks moved shortcuts, rarely needed.

name: Disable UPnP / Network Discovery
description: Stop SSDP Discovery, UPnP host, and Function Discovery (Resource Publication + Provider Host) — only needed for DLNA/media sharing and browsing other devices in Explorer's Network tab.

name: Disable Smart Card Stack
description: Stop SCardSvr / ScDeviceEnum / SCPolicySvc — no smart-card reader needed.

name: Disable Image Acquisition
description: Stop Windows Image Acquisition (stisvc) — only for scanners/old cameras.

name: Disable Phone Service
description: Stop the Phone Service (PhoneSvc) — phone-call integration, usually idle.

name: Disable Hotspot & Parental
description: Stop Mobile Hotspot (icssvc) and Parental Controls (WpcMonSvc).

name: Disable Insider Service
description: Stop the Windows Insider service (wisvc).

name: Disable User Sync Services
description: Disable per-user data services (OneSync, Messaging, Contacts/Unistore/UserData) — breaks Mail/Calendar/People sync.

name: Disable CDP (Connected Devices Platform)
description: Disable the base Connected Devices Platform service (CDPSvc) and its per-user instance (CDPUserSvc) — chatty background callbacks behind Nearby Sharing / Continue on PC.

name: Disable Push Notifications
description: Stop WpnService + per-user WpnUserService — disables toast notifications, removes their hosts.

name: Disable Update Orchestrator
description: Stop UsoSvc + wuauserv — no Windows Updates until reverted. Removes update background hosts.

name: Hide Security Tray Icon
description: Stop SecurityHealthSystray.exe at logon. Windows Defender protection stays fully ON — only the tray icon process is removed.

name: Remove Bing News & Weather
description: Uninstall the Bing News and Weather apps — kills their background tile/feed updaters.

name: Remove Phone Link
description: Uninstall Phone Link (YourPhone) — removes PhoneExperienceHost background process.

name: Remove Groove & Movies
description: Uninstall Groove Music (ZuneMusic) and Movies & TV (ZuneVideo).

name: Remove Teams (Chat)
description: Uninstall the consumer Teams / Chat app — removes its background host.

name: Remove Clipchamp
description: Uninstall the Clipchamp video editor app.

name: Remove Help & Get Started
description: Uninstall the Get Help and Tips/Get Started apps.

name: Remove People & Feedback
description: Uninstall the People app and the Feedback Hub.

name: Remove Maps, To Do, Office Hub
description: Uninstall Windows Maps, Microsoft To Do and the Office hub stub.

name: Remove Cortana & Mixed Reality
description: Uninstall the Cortana app and the Mixed Reality Portal.

name: Remove Promoted Junk (Candy Crush etc.)
description: Uninstall the auto-installed promoted apps Windows drops on you — Candy Crush & other King games, Disney+, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Netflix, Prime Video, Spotify stub, LinkedIn, Solitaire, Duolingo and friends. One toggle. Reinstall any from the Store if you actually want it.

name: Remove Dev Home, Family & Journal
description: Uninstall Dev Home, Family Safety, Journal and Whiteboard — preinstalled apps with background components most people never open.

name: Remove Quick Assist & New Outlook
description: Uninstall the Quick Assist remote-help app and the promoted 'new Outlook' web-wrapper stub.

name: Disable Google Update
description: Stop the Google Update services (gupdate/gupdatem) — Chrome's idle background updater. Update Chrome manually via its menu.

name: Disable Edge Update
description: Stop the Microsoft Edge update services (edgeupdate/edgeupdatem) and elevation service.

name: Disable Updater Tasks
description: Disable common third-party auto-update scheduled tasks (Google, Edge, OneDrive) that spawn background processes.

name: Ultimate Performance
description: Unlock AND activate the hidden Ultimate Performance power plan — max clocks, best sustained FPS on a desktop with real cooling. On a thermally-limited laptop this can do the opposite: confirmed case of a laptop gaining ~100 FPS by switching back to the Windows-recommended Balanced plan, because \

name: Disable Sleep (AC)
description: Never sleep while plugged in.

name: Disable Hibernate
description: Free hiberfil.sys disk space, stop hibernate bookkeeping, and speed up shutdown. Also disables Fast Startup.

name: Disable Fast Startup
description: Ensure a clean boot, avoid stale driver state.

name: Fast App Kill
description: 2s app-kill timeout on shutdown.

name: NTFS Optimization
description: Tune NTFS memory usage and disable last-access stamps.

name: IRQ8 Priority
description: Boost IRQ8 interrupt priority. May conflict on some hardware.

name: No 8.3 Names
description: Disable NTFS 8.3 short-name generation. Faster file creation.

name: Auto Game Boost
description: Automatically detects when a fullscreen game is running and pins it to your fastest cores (Intel P-cores / AMD CCD-0), pushes Discord/browsers/background apps onto the rest, raises the game's priority and turns off power throttling. Everything restores instantly when the game closes. No per-game setup.

name: Game-Time Power Plan
description: Switch to the VOIDTUNE Performance power plan the moment a fullscreen game starts, and back to your normal plan when it closes — max clocks during play, normal power/heat/noise the rest of the time (the pattern Bitsum recommends instead of running an aggressive plan 24/7). Needs the \

name: Game Mode
description: Enable Windows Game Mode.

name: MMCSS Games = High
description: High scheduling category for game tasks.

name: No Overlay Hooks
description: Disable fullscreen-exclusive overlay hooks.

name: Fullscreen Optim Off
description: Disable DWM fullscreen optimizations for lower input lag.

name: DWM Flush Rate
description: Force DWM to flush every frame, reduces microstutter.

name: CPU Priority Games
description: Boost game thread priority via MMCSS.

name: No USB Suspend
description: Prevent USB devices powering off mid-game (input stutter).

name: GPU MSI Mode
description: Enable Message Signaled Interrupts on the GPU only, if supported. Can lower DPC latency, but on some GPU/driver combos it does the opposite and adds stutter. Opt-in; takes effect after reboot.

name: Disable UWP Background
description: Revoke background execution for all UWP/modern apps globally.

name: Disable Compat Tasks
description: Stop Application Experience / Appraiser background tasks.

name: Disable CEIP Tasks
description: Stop Customer Experience Improvement Program tasks.

name: Disable Feedback Tasks
description: Stop Windows Feedback / Siuf telemetry collection tasks.

name: Disable Disk Diag Task
description: Stop the Microsoft Disk Diagnostic data collector.

name: Disable WER Tasks
description: Stop Windows Error Reporting background queue tasks.

name: Startup Delay = 0
description: Startup apps open instantly instead of staggered.

name: Disable Delivery Opt
description: Stop Delivery Optimization background upload tasks.

name: StorAHCI MSI Mode
description: Enable MSI for storage controllers (NVMe/SATA AHCI).

name: Enable Write Cache
description: Enable disk write caching for better sequential write performance.

name: TRIM All SSDs
description: Run TRIM optimisation on all fixed drives now (one-shot).

name: NTFS Disable Encrypt
description: Disable NTFS on-disk encryption overhead (not BitLocker).

name: NTFS Large MFT
description: Reserve maximum MFT space (zone 4) to reduce fragmentation.

name: Disable NTFS Journal
description: Delete the NTFS change journal on C:. Breaks VSS shadow copies.

name: Disable Audio Enhancements
description: Disable system-wide audio DSP effects that add buffer latency.

name: MMCSS Audio = High
description: High scheduling for the audio thread. Lower underrun risk.

name: Exclusive Audio Mode
description: Let apps (DAW, games) claim exclusive device control for lowest buffers.

name: Disable Auto Ducking
description: Stop Windows lowering other audio when comms apps are active.

name: Disable Audio Logging
description: Disable audio engine debug/event logging.

name: Disable Telemetry Services
description: Kill DiagTrack and dmwappushservice.

name: Disable Location
description: Block location access for apps.

name: Disable Activity Feed
description: Stop timeline / activity tracking.

name: Disable Windows Update
description: Stop the Windows Update service. Re-enable to get updates.

name: Disable Search Highlights
description: Remove the rotating web content in the taskbar search box. (Windows 11)

name: No Startup App Delay
description: Launch startup apps immediately instead of Windows' staggered delay.

name: Cloudflare DNS
description: Use 1.1.1.1 / 1.0.0.1 — consistently among the fastest public resolvers. Revert returns to your router / DHCP DNS.

name: No Edge Preload
description: Stop Microsoft Edge from pre-launching and running in the background when closed.

name: Disable Windows Recall
description: Turn off Windows Recall / AI screen-snapshotting (Copilot+ PCs) and its background data analysis. Frees NPU/CPU cycles and disk; harmless on PCs that don't have it.

name: Disable Consumer Features
description: Stop Windows silently auto-installing suggested/promoted apps (Candy Crush, etc.) and their background installers.

name: Disable Background Apps
description: Globally stop UWP/Store apps running in the background — a big cut to idle process count. Win32 apps (games, Discord, browsers) are unaffected.

name: Disable Notifications
description: Turn off toast notifications and the notification center — stops their background push work.

name: Disable Storage Sense (Per-User)
description: Stop the automatic background disk-cleanup service from waking periodically.

name: Prefer IPv4 + No Teredo
description: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6 and disable the Teredo tunneling adapter — removes an idle network component. IPv6 itself stays on.

name: Enable Long Paths
description: Allow file paths longer than 260 characters — prevents deep-folder errors for games/dev tools. Pure win, no downside.

name: Block WPBT Binaries
description: Block the Windows Platform Binary Table — stops motherboard firmware from silently injecting OEM executables at boot. Safe on most systems; revert if a vendor tool stops working.

name: Disable Telemetry Tasks
description: Disable the scheduled tasks that wake periodically to collect telemetry (Compatibility Appraiser, Customer Experience Improvement, disk diagnostics). Fewer background wake-ups.

name: Group svchost Processes
description: Merge the many split svchost.exe hosts into a few grouped ones — a big cut to the process count on systems with plenty of RAM. Sets the split threshold to your installed memory. (Needs 8 GB+; takes effect after reboot.)

name: Block Driver Updates in WU
description: Stop Windows Update from silently replacing your GPU/chipset drivers with its own (often older) versions. You still get security updates; just not driver overwrites.

name: Faster Shutdown
description: Cut the timeouts Windows waits for services/apps during shutdown — snappier shutdown, no multi-second hang on close. Doesn't touch running apps: the aggressive auto-kill-hung-apps variant of this tweak made Windows restart Explorer mid-session and was removed.

name: Disable Error Reporting
description: Turn off Windows Error Reporting — removes the WerFault / WerSvc background work that fires on every app hiccup.

name: Disable Fax Service
description: Stop the Fax service — virtually unused on a modern PC.

name: Disable Offline Maps Svc
description: Stop the Downloaded Maps Manager (MapsBroker) — only needed if you use the Windows Maps app offline.

name: Disable Media Player Sharing
description: Stop Windows Media Player Network Sharing (WMPNetworkSvc) — legacy DLNA streaming, rarely used.

name: Disable Remote Registry
description: Stop Remote Registry — lets other machines edit your registry over the network. No legitimate use on a home PC, and disabling it closes a real attack surface.

name: Disable Internet Connection Sharing
description: Stop the Internet Connection Sharing service (SharedAccess) — only needed if you're sharing this PC's connection with other devices.

name: Disable Retail Demo Mode
description: Stop Retail Demo service — exists only for store-floor kiosk PCs.

name: Disable Xbox Background Services
description: Stop the Xbox Live Auth Manager, Game Save, Networking and Accessory services — background processes for the Xbox app / Game Pass. Steam, Epic, Riot and FiveM don't need any of these; only disable if you don't use the Xbox app or Xbox cloud saves.

name: De-prioritize Background Processes (IFEO)
description: Lower the CPU/I-O scheduling priority of SearchIndexer, ctfmon, fontdrvhost and sihost via Image File Execution Options — the same documented mechanism Windows itself uses for foreground-app boosting, just aimed the other way. These keep running (nothing is disabled) but yield CPU/disk to your game the moment it needs it.

name: Disable Automatic Maintenance Wake
description: Stop Automatic Maintenance from waking your PC from sleep to run its nightly task swarm (defrag, telemetry, .NET NGEN, disk diagnostics) — a common cause of \

name: Disable Fault Tolerant Heap
description: Turns off the Fault Tolerant Heap subsystem, which silently applies per-app memory-allocation shims to anything that has crashed before — a documented, measurable slowdown for apps with lots of small allocations (Microsoft's own docs note the perf cost; multiple game/render-software vendors tell users to disable it for exactly this reason).

name: Disable Explorer Auto Folder-Type Discovery
description: Stops Explorer from inspecting every folder's contents to guess whether it's Pictures/Music/Videos/General and forcing a single generic template instead — removes the disk churn and open-lag on large or networked folders. Cosmetic-only downside: folder view columns become uniform.

name: Disable Bluetooth Stack
description: Stop the Bluetooth Support Service, Audio Gateway and per-user Bluetooth service template — removes their persistent processes entirely. Only apply if you have no Bluetooth radio or don't use Bluetooth mice/headsets/controllers, since this breaks all of them.

name: Disable Print Spooler
description: Stop the Print Spooler service and its notification helper (PrintNotify), which run even with no printer attached — Spooler is also a notorious attack surface (PrintNightmare). Breaks ALL printing and some \

name: Disable Sensor & Biometric Services
description: Stop the ambient-light/orientation sensor services and Windows Biometric Service — idle overhead on any desktop with no sensors. Breaks auto-brightness, auto-rotate, and Windows Hello fingerprint/face login where present.

name: Disable Remote Desktop Services
description: Stop Remote Desktop Services, its user-mode port redirector and session-env helper — removes idle processes and a real remote-access attack surface. Breaks inbound Remote Desktop and Remote Assistance/Quick Assist; skip if you ever connect to this PC remotely.

name: Disable Shell Hardware Detection
description: Stop AutoPlay's hardware-detection service — Automatic by default, real background footprint. Only loses the AutoPlay prompt when inserting USB drives/discs; manually opening them in Explorer still works fine.

name: Disable Windows Search
description: Stop the Windows Search indexer (WSearch) — one of the heaviest background services on a stock install (Automatic-Delayed by default). Breaks Start Menu app/file search and Explorer's search box (still works, just does a slow live scan instead of using the index).

name: Disable File/Printer Sharing (Server Service)
description: Stop the Server service (LanmanServer) — Automatic by default even though most single-PC gaming setups never share a folder or printer from this machine. Breaks SMB file sharing, printer sharing, and being visible to other PCs on the network as a share target.

name: Disable IP Helper
description: Stop IP Helper (iphlpsvc) — Automatic by default, handles IPv6 transition tunneling (Teredo/6to4/ISATAP). Real background service, but disabling can break IPv6 connectivity or specific VPN clients that depend on it — only apply if you're on IPv4-only networking and don't use an affected VPN.

name: Restore Network
description: Reset TCP/IP global settings to defaults.

name: Restore Power
description: Switch back to the Balanced power plan.

name: Re-enable Services
description: Restore SysMain and DiagTrack to automatic.

name: Restore Visual FX
description: Re-enable Windows animations and effects.

name: Fix Stutter — Restore Memory Defaults
description: Undoes the memory tweaks that stall a DRAM-less SSD under disk load: re-enables RAM compression, resets NTFS memory usage, re-enables page combining, and clears any leftover DPC-watchdog override. Use this if games/audio freeze for a few seconds during big file transfers or Windows Update.

name: Full Reset to Windows Defaults
description: The clean slate. Resets power plans (unparks cores), timers, GPU scheduling, memory management, and the whole TCP/IP stack back to stock — including tweaks that were removed from the catalog and can no longer be toggled off. Reboot after. Use this to get a known-good baseline before applying a fresh set.

name: Restore CPU Turbo Boost
description: Removes a leftover from older VOIDTUNE versions (\
